# githubsettings_repository_archived_settings (Resource)

Records the merge settings of an archived repository without changing them. Set each argument to the value GitHub reports. Apply fails while the configured values differ. Give the token read access to the repository.

Removing this resource from Terraform management leaves the GitHub setting in place.

## Import the current setting

Read the current values with the GitHub CLI. Set [`GITHUB_TOKEN`](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/githubsettings/latest/docs#authentication) first so this command and Terraform use the same token. Replace `OWNER` and `REPOSITORY`.

```shell
GH_TOKEN="${GITHUB_TOKEN:?Set GITHUB_TOKEN first}" gh api --hostname github.com repos/OWNER/REPOSITORY \
  -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10" \
  --jq '{
  archived,
  allow_auto_merge,
  allow_forking,
  allow_merge_commit,
  allow_rebase_merge,
  allow_squash_merge,
  allow_update_branch,
  delete_branch_on_merge,
  merge_commit_message,
  merge_commit_title,
  squash_merge_commit_message,
  squash_merge_commit_title,
  web_commit_signoff_required
}'
```

Confirm that `archived` is `true`. Use the other returned values as resource arguments. If a merge setting is missing, check the repository access and the [API requirements for merge settings](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos#get-a-repository).

Add the import block below to a Terraform project configured with `elephant-evergreen/githubsettings`. The [quickstart](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/githubsettings/latest/docs#import-a-policy) shows the provider block and initialization. Replace the example ID and address with those of your resource.

```terraform
import {
  to = githubsettings_repository_archived_settings.example
  id = "example-owner/example-repository"
}
```

1. Add the resource block with arguments that match the current GitHub values.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan` and keep a plan that contains only the import. If it proposes a change, compare the differing values with the current policy and save a new plan.
3. Apply the saved plan.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "githubsettings_repository_archived_settings" "example" {
  owner      = "example-owner"
  repository = "example-repository"

  allow_auto_merge            = false
  allow_forking               = false
  allow_merge_commit          = true
  allow_rebase_merge          = true
  allow_squash_merge          = true
  allow_update_branch         = false
  delete_branch_on_merge      = false
  merge_commit_message        = "PR_TITLE"
  merge_commit_title          = "MERGE_MESSAGE"
  squash_merge_commit_message = "COMMIT_MESSAGES"
  squash_merge_commit_title   = "COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE"
  web_commit_signoff_required = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allow_auto_merge` (Boolean) Allow auto-merge for pull requests.
- `allow_forking` (Boolean) Allow users to fork the repository.
- `allow_merge_commit` (Boolean) Allow merge commits.
- `allow_rebase_merge` (Boolean) Allow rebase merging.
- `allow_squash_merge` (Boolean) Allow squash merging.
- `allow_update_branch` (Boolean) Allow branches to be updated from their pull requests.
- `delete_branch_on_merge` (Boolean) Delete head branches after pull requests merge.
- `merge_commit_message` (String) Merge commit message. Allowed values are PR_BODY, PR_TITLE, BLANK.
- `merge_commit_title` (String) Merge commit title. Allowed values are PR_TITLE, MERGE_MESSAGE.
- `owner` (String) GitHub account that owns the repository or organization.
- `repository` (String) GitHub repository name within the owner account.
- `squash_merge_commit_message` (String) Squash merge commit message. Allowed values are PR_BODY, COMMIT_MESSAGES, BLANK.
- `squash_merge_commit_title` (String) Squash merge commit title. Allowed values are PR_TITLE, COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE.
- `web_commit_signoff_required` (Boolean) Require contributors to sign off on web-based commits.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether GitHub reports the repository as archived.
